capabilities: Review CriticMarkup marks in a side panel with one card per mark
Accept, reject, or reply to suggestions directly in the Markdown
Insert or mark selections with CriticMarkup forms via commands and a right-click submenu
Finalize all remaining markup in one pass for publishing
Track vault-wide pending changes in an overview list with per-file counts
disambiguation: Not a version-history or file-diff tool; it reviews CriticMarkup marks embedded in note text.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the companion Claude Code agent plugin is third-party and not maintained by this plugin's author.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to review, accept, or reject CriticMarkup edit suggestions left in notes, such as those produced by AI agents.
summary: Side-panel reviewer for CriticMarkup suggestions in notes, letting you accept, reject, or reply to each mark and write results back into the Markdown.
